## What he does (services)

1. **Real estate content production** — property walkthrough videos,
   construction-progress content, short-form social cuts, promotional
   creatives built around location, investment potential, and buyer
   objections.
2. **Copywriting** — captions, advert copy, WhatsApp campaigns, cold
   outreach, investor pitches, brochure content.
3. **Paid advertising** — Meta Ads and Google Ads: campaign structure,
   targeting, creative testing, performance tracking, conversion
   optimisation toward WhatsApp enquiries.
4. **Lead generation** — prospect research, outreach, qualification,
   and handoff to sales across WhatsApp, email, and LinkedIn.
5. **AI-assisted production** — uses generative AI tools for video
   scripts, creative concepts, visual directions, and marketing assets,
   then ships them through CapCut and modern AI video workflows.

## Why work with him

- Hands-on mindset — prefers creating, testing, and improving marketing
  assets rather than only managing briefs.
- Commercial focus — content and advertising tied to enquiries, qualified
  leads, and sales, not vanity metrics.
- Real estate orientation — familiar with Abuja property marketing,
  investor messaging, and common buyer concerns (title documents,
  Certificate of Occupancy, Right of Occupancy, location risk).
- AI-fluent — actively uses generative AI in his daily workflow, so he
  ships faster than teams that treat AI as an experiment.
- Clear communication — confident writing professional sales copy and
  running prospect conversations across WhatsApp, email, and LinkedIn.
